modelResponse.episodeSummary: 55yo male, Non-Sustained Ventricular Tachycardia (NSVT), warning severity, hemodynamically stable
modelResponse.rhythm: Non-Sustained Ventricular Tachycardia (NSVT) with multifocal PVCs
keyECGEvidence: morphology: Sinus beats with multifocal wide PVCs, couplets, one non-sustained VT run of 4 beats
modelResponse.mechanism: Low intracellular potassium and magnesium levels increase myocardial irritability and lower the threshold for ventricular automaticity and re-entry, leading to multifocal PVCs and NSVT.

rejectedAlternatives.why: Troponin T 0.02 ng/mL is only mildly elevated and consistent with post-op status; no significant ST deviation noted.
No digoxin in medication list; morphology shows multifocal PVCs rather than classic digoxin-induced bigeminy.

recommendedActions: Administer intravenous potassium chloride (KCl) to correct K 3.1 mmol/L LOW
Administer intravenous magnesium sulfate to correct Mg 1.5 mg/dL LOW
Continue continuous cardiac monitoring to monitor PVC burden and NSVT
Withhold/Review Hydrochlorothiazide use in light of electrolyte depletion
Monitor repeat serum electrolytes (K and Mg) in 4-6 hours
